embervoid.remnant.name: Ash Remnant of %s

embervoid.remnant.burned: Your previous Ash Remnant crumbled to nothing
embervoid.remnant.xp_burned: The XP in your previous Ash Remnant burned away; any items stay in it
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.embervoid: The world is fading. A dark fantasy adventure: dungeons, bosses and cursed gear.
embervoid.levelup.level_cap: You have reached the highest level
embervoid.realm.locked: The flame has not reached this realm
embervoid.realm.gate.open: The Sealed Gate yields to you
embervoid.realm.gate.sealed: The gate is sealed. Guardians still standing: %s
embervoid.realm.gate.forming: The gate yields, but the depths beyond are still forming
embervoid.lodestar.cold: The lodestar is cold outside the realms
embervoid.lodestar.none: No guardian left to face here
embervoid.boss.fog: A wall of ash bars the way
embervoid.boss.first_kill: %s has fallen. Its Ember Heart is yours
embervoid.shrine.kindled: The arena's shrine kindles for you
embervoid.realm.completed: The realm falls silent. The next obelisk stirs
embervoid.shrine.rested: You rest by the ember. Your flasks are full again
embervoid.shrine.dormant: The flame does not answer you
embervoid.obelisk.dark: The flame has not reached it
embervoid.sanctum.attuned.subtitle: The ember knows you now
embervoid.flask_shard.tooltip: Offer it at an Ember Shrine to deepen your flask
embervoid.flask_shard.offered: The ember takes the shard. Your flask holds %s charges
embervoid.flask_shard.max: Your flask can hold no more
embervoid.maiden.greeting: Ashen Maiden: Rest, wanderer. The ember will keep.
embervoid.levelup.capped: This stat is at its peak
embervoid.stat.endurance.desc: Stamina and its regeneration, knockback resistance
embervoid.stat.strength.desc: Damage with axes and heavy weapons
embervoid.stat.dexterity.desc: Damage with swords and bows, attack speed
embervoid.stat.resilience.desc: Armor toughness, resistance to fire, poison and wither
embervoid.stat.fortune.desc: Luck: loot quality and rare drops
embervoid.moon.subtitle.full_moon: The dead will not rest tonight
embervoid.moon.started.full_moon: The full moon rises. Beds will not help you tonight.
embervoid.moon.started.blood_new_moon: The blood new moon rises. Beds will not help you tonight.
embervoid.moon.ended.timeout: The night could not hold any longer. %s
embervoid.moon.no_sleep: You cannot sleep on a moon night
embervoid.moon.curse.stack: The Curse of the Night deepens (%s). It lifts when the full moon sets.
embervoid.wave.zombies: The full moon raises %s Ashen Zombies for your curse
embervoid.wave.ghosts: No curse on you: %s Ghosts come instead
embervoid.wave.cleared: Your full moon wave is beaten
embervoid.wave.shard: The ghosts leave a Flask Shard behind
embervoid.vampire.talk.0: A lovely night, is it not? The moon hides her face for us.
embervoid.vampire.talk.1: Do not be alarmed. I only came to admire the dark.
embervoid.vampire.talk.2: Your heart beats so loudly... forgive me, I am listening.
embervoid.vampire.talk.3: Stay a while. Dawn is still very far away.
embervoid.vampire.arrived: Pale figures step out of the dark. They seem friendly... for now.
embervoid.vampire.provoked: %s struck a Vampire. It sheds its disguise!
embervoid.vampire.impatient: The Vampire grows tired of waiting and sheds its disguise!
embervoid.vampire.boss.first_kill: The Vampire falls. Its fang and %s Flask Shard(s) are yours
embervoid.vampire.boss.beaten: The Vampire is destroyed. The blood moon wanes
embervoid.vampire.boss.won: No one is left to face the Vampire. It melts into the night, laughing
embervoid.vampire.boss.left: With no one to hunt, the Vampire melts into the night
embervoid.vampire.arena.pulled: The blood moon drags you into the Vampire's domain
embervoid.vampire.arena.remnant_moved: Your remnant was carried out of the Vampire's domain to %s %s %s
item.embervoid.smoldering_ingot.tooltip: Metal of all three districts, fused in a flame that will not die
item.embervoid.ash_colossus_soul.tooltip: It carried the granary stones on its back while the market burned
item.embervoid.grieving_tree_soul.toolti: The king's oak. Every lantern on it was a hider of the flame
item.embervoid.crypt_keeper_soul.tooltip: It kept the unburied dead below, one lantern for them all
item.embervoid.smoldering_lord_soul.tool: The greedy king's flame, still clutched in a dead hand
item.embervoid.ash_of_rematch.tooltip: Scattered on the shrine of a fallen guardian, it calls the guardian back. Its soul does not return
item.embervoid.flask_ember.tooltip: A spark of the king's hoarded flame. Fed to the flask, it strengthens every sip
embervoid.reliquary.title: Reliquary
item.embervoid.last_harvest_grain.desc: The last sheaf, kept back when the flame was taken from the altars.
item.embervoid.ploughmans_horseshoe.desc: It kept turning furrows long after the ploughman was ash.
item.embervoid.royal_hound_fang.desc: From the king's own pack. It never let go of the hunt.
item.embervoid.amber_tear.desc: Sap the old oak wept for the burning woods.
item.embervoid.gravestone_medallion.desc: Chipped from a stone that names no one.
item.embervoid.ferrymans_coin.desc: Fare for a crossing the burned were never granted.
item.embervoid.wardens_chain.desc: It held the dead in their crypts. Now it holds you up.
item.embervoid.seal_of_the_ashen_king.de: He sealed the Ember away with it. The wax still burns.
embervoid.gear.smoldering.set: burning does not hurt you (lava still does)
item.embervoid.couriers_ring.desc: The royal courier outran the fire. Not the smoke.
item.embervoid.ring_of_ash_feathers.desc: Woven from the feathers of birds that burned in flight.
item.embervoid.ring_of_ash_feathers.effe: Slower falling; no fall damage below 8 blocks (sneak to drop)
item.embervoid.ring_of_the_fog_stalker.d: The king's huntsmen saw through the grey. The game did not.
item.embervoid.ring_of_the_fog_stalker.e: The realm's fog clears twice as far (not in boss arenas)
item.embervoid.delvers_ring.desc: Worn smooth on a hand that dug where the king forbade.
item.embervoid.delvers_ring.effect: Haste I while mining realm ores
item.embervoid.drowned_mans_ring.desc: He fled the fire into the sinkhole and never needed air again.
item.embervoid.ring_of_embers.desc: A spark of the hoarded flame, still trying to get out.
item.embervoid.ring_of_embers.effect: Melee hits set the target on fire for 2 seconds
embervoid.gear.warden.set: +0.3 knockback resistance, -15% damage taken while blocking
embervoid.gear.scarecrow_mask.piece: Mobs notice you at half the distance; Ash Stalkers do not ambush you
embervoid.gear.huntsman_greaves.piece: +20% speed for 4 s after a kill; no fall damage up to 7 blocks
embervoid.gear.furnace_heart_cuirass.pie: Below 30% health: a fire nova burns and throws back foes around you (once per 60 s)
death.attack.embervoid.ember.item: %1$s was burned to ash by %2$s using %3$s
